Brand rules

Colour

Four colours only. No tints, gradients or shadows. Click a chip to copy its HEX.

Type

Headline in black, key phrase in red.
Font
Akzidenz-Grotesk Pro, Bold and Regular, for everything
Case
Sentence case, flush left, ends with a period.

Layout

Margin
M ≈ 7.4% of the short side
Notch
X × 18X, X = M ÷ 5, ends angled 26.5°. Left edge, top aligned to the label.
Container
Official sizes only, 3.75 × 5 to 6.25 × 8 in. Always taller than wide.

Logo

Lockup
Sonim, a NEXA company. Wordmark alone below 100 px wide.
Colour
Single colour only
Place
Bottom-left, on the margin
Min
50 px / 0.5 in

Icons

Official Sonim line icons: black line, one red detail. The rugged-standard icons carry the red check-shield badge. See Brand assets.

Never

  • ×Red type on black
  • ×Gray type on white
  • ×Tinted or filtered photography
  • ×All caps or Title Case
Copy to FigmaHover any template and click Copy SVG, then press Ctrl/Cmd + V in Figma. For many at once, use Figma import view: pick a set, then run your HTML to Figma plugin.
